/* 종류별 사용량 조회 */ SELECT EXTL_API_SE_CD , COUNT(*) AS CALL_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN CALL_RSLT_CD = #{successCd} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS FAIL_CNT , ROUND(AVG(RSPNS_MS)) AS AVG_RSPNS_MS FROM EXTL_API_CALL_LOG WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY EXTL_API_SE_CD

/* 일별 사용량 조회 */ SELECT DATE(CALL_DT) AS CALL_YMD , EXTL_API_SE_CD , COUNT(*) AS CALL_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN CALL_RSLT_CD = #{successCd} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS FAIL_CNT , ROUND(AVG(RSPNS_MS)) AS AVG_RSPNS_MS FROM EXTL_API_CALL_LOG WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY DATE(CALL_DT), EXTL_API_SE_CD ORDER BY CALL_YMD DESC, EXTL_API_SE_CD

/* 실패 목록 조회 */ SELECT EXTL_API_CALL_LOG_SN , CALL_DT , EXTL_API_SE_CD , CALL_RSLT_CD , FAIL_RSN FROM EXTL_API_CALL_LOG WHERE CALL_RSLT_CD <> #{successCd}
ORDER BY CALL_DT DESC, EXTL_API_CALL_LOG_SN DESC
